_about: Tidebreak round 3: the movement set of the % ring (the MOVE task's file; smash_r3 spec §4, §5.3-5.4, §14.2): physics, jumps (the hop-cast window), the double jump (its carry kept), drift, fast fall, the guard's roll and duck, the air dodge, the teeter, the edge (deck-relative keys, the grab limit), the Rise per element, the camera (deck, off the deck, hang, recover_turn), sounds on yourself, clips. Read by RingMoves only while a stock-rules ring is on (a body with a RingMoves child). Times in s, lengths in m, speeds in m/s.

physics._about: spec §4.1: one gravity for every body's own falls and every launch (BendKnock.gravity_override wins when set); max fall (air's own); the run and sprint; the deck's accel/decel; air_friction: what an air drift with no key held loses (m/s^2); the carry's decay for RingMoves.simulate only (the engine's is BendKnock's)

drift._about: spec §4.1: air drift per element [m/s, m/s^2]

jump._about: spec §4.1: Space is always the full jump (apex_m); the short hop (short_apex_m) is Space within hop_cast_s of a cast's release, either order; self_up_mult: round 2's Step, Jets, Lift and Leap up speeds x this in the ring (sqrt(20/9.8))

double_jump._about: spec §4.2: height (per element), the launch carry kept (BendKnock.scale_carry), your own flat speed kept with nothing held; the Rise wants a fresh Space rise_after_s after it

fast_fall._about: spec §4.3: C after the apex (vy <= after_vy) sets vy -mps until you land, jump or dodge

crouch._about: spec §4.3: C held on the deck: this capsule, stationary

ground_dodge._about: spec §4.5: guard up (or within guard_window_s of E) + a fresh direction = Roll; + C = Duck. Intangible windows from the start; the repeat cost adds repeat_add_s of end lag per Roll or Duck within repeat_s of the last one's end, up to repeat_max_s; rolls stop lip_keep_m inside the lip

air_dodge._about: spec §4.6: 3 in the air, once per airtime. Directional: m in s, gravity off, vy 0 after, then end_s with no actions (drift on, no grab); neutral: keep of your velocity, gravity on. Landing during it: land_lag_s

piece_edge._about: A team arena's raised pieces (RingMoves._piece_guard, _drop_off; the owner, 2026-10-10: "Shift + Space drops"): walking stops where the floor drops more than drop_m within look_m ahead; Shift + Space within reach_m of such an edge hops down off it, hop_mps out and hop_up_mps up.

teeter._about: spec §4.7: running stops lip_m inside the lip; holding toward the water step_off_s steps off; hold_dot: how square to the water the held keys must be

edge._about: spec §5.3: the grab box (the head, head_m over the feet: box_in_m inside the lip to box_out_m out, box_low_m to box_high_m about the lip), the snap (feet snap_feet_m under the lip, snap_out_m off the face), corners, the hang, the 3-grab rule, occupancy (occupy_m each side, no trumping), the options (deck-relative: any direction climbs, E rolls in, Space jumps, a click attacks, only C lets go)

rise._about: Space once the double jump is spent, off the deck only (feet outside the deck or more than off_under_m under the lip), a fresh press rise_after_s after the double jump, once per airtime. After travel, normal air steering, attacks and any unused dodge return; the Rise and double jump stay spent. Landing recovery keeps helpless_lag_s (the existing data key); helpless_drift applies only to an explicitly restricted state. The scramble: a Rise meeting the face (during it or scramble_after_s after) with the head at most scramble_m under the grab box slides up to the hang in scramble_s (face_m: touching the face, its plinth foot included). Per element: startup (the tell), travel m in s (drift share), its hit (tag, d %, set m/s, angle, hit_r), its loud tell sound. The in-ring Rise (the owner 2026-10-11: "the tripple jump should allow the arena jump back button ... with its own cooldown", 6 s, the way back kept): the same third press over the deck is the element's Rise straight up from where he is (the Jet along the aim), its tell there; once every ring_cooldown_s, and it never spends the airtime's Rise for the way back (none in an airtime whose Rise the way back spent). The HUD's Rise pip shows it over the deck, the way back's off it.

water._stream: The owner, 2026-10-12: "the water return water jump it shoots straight up ... it should be like the fire but with water the user uses the aim to move like a dragon": a stream of water out of the tank carries him along his aim (pitch floored at pitch_floor_deg), turning toward the aim all through it at turn_deg_s, its body trailing back to the water.

hitstun._about: spec §3.2-3.3: the escape opens at escape_s (a fresh Space or 3 then ends it; the buffered press never does); the steer read di_read_s after a launch; the body's lean toward the held side for lean_s (lean_deg of roll, twist_deg of twist)
hitstun._clips: the knock's look: launched down faster than spike_vy (a Slam's spike) plays knock_spiked until he lands; a bounce off the deck plays knock_bounce for bounce_clip_s

break_fall._about: spec §3.4 (the motion; PERCENT judges): stand intangible; the roll; the wall's stick and spring

getup._about: spec §3.4: from lying, W or Space stands (intangible), E + a direction rolls, a click is the getup attack (all round)

spout._about: spec §7.2: a move this strong leaves the spout

cam._about: spec §4.8: the deck's arm and pivot; off the deck the pivot between the chest (chest_m up) and the nearest lip, arm off_base + off_k x distance (clamped), fov / fov_far beyond far_m, eased in_s / out_s; hanging; the recovery turn (owner: yes): off the deck, out of hitstun, the lip more than turn_beyond_deg from the view, the mouse still mouse_still_s: the yaw eases toward the lip at up to turn_dps until within turn_until_deg (turn_k: deg/s per deg left); any mouse motion stops it for the airtime

sounds._about: spec §3.2, §5.4: your own sounds (the local player's ears only, our own synthesis: RingMoveLooks): the hitstun whoosh, the escape tick, the helpless 'spent', the exhale; their levels (dB)

shadow._about: spec §3.4: your own soft drop shadow (the local player only): its size and darkness at the feet, fading and growing with height

clips._about: spec §13: each body state's clip (CLIPS' exact names) and its stand-in while the clip is not in yet (BendPoses passes over a missing name); loop: held as a loop; mask: the layer (full, upper); lift_m: a stand-in's raise of the body (the hang's hands and head over the lip until its clip lands). Round 5 (CLIPWIRE): spout_step_off the step off the spout (SwayPose and NpcBody, as the ride ends with no cast and no other state); struck_<side> the hit-stop's contact pose by where the hit came from (BendImpact, shown through the hold, then the tumble or the flinch)

words._about: player-facing names (the owner's word rules: tests/ring/test_player_words.gd)
